entities.summary: Denis Noble is a British physiologist and biologist who held the Burdon Sanderson Chair of Cardiovascular Physiology at the University of Oxford from 1984 to 2004 and was appointed professor emeritus and co-director of computational physiology. He is one of the pioneers of systems biology and developed the first viable model of the working heart in 1960.
